LanguageData.IRC_EnableHumanRaidsDesc: Conservatively replaces pairs of low-tier raiders with a stronger vanilla pawn kind from the same faction group. No combat stat buffs are added.
LanguageData.IRC_EnableMechanoidRaidsDesc: Promotes same-role models from the current vanilla group. Breachers and existing bosses are preserved; a mixed force may very rarely gain at most one boss from its own weighted vanilla pool.
LanguageData.IRC_EnablePhasedMechanoidWavesDesc: For oversized pure-role swarms using safe edge arrivals, builds two or three point-qualified waves and merges weak tails. Reinforcements join the original raid Lord and share its current wait/attack state.
LanguageData.IRC_EnableTacticalMechDrops: Drop reinforcements safely near surviving attackers
LanguageData.IRC_EnableTacticalMechDropsDesc: Uses vanilla drop pods near the original raid's surviving units, but rejects player pawns, player buildings, home area, roofs, and fog. Falls back to the original edge arrival when no safe cluster exists.
LanguageData.IRC_EnableManhunterPacksDesc: Only uses a stronger vanilla animal with compatible behavior, speed, body size, armor, and abilities. Keeps the vanilla pack when none exists. No stat buffs are added.
LanguageData.IRC_EnableMechClustersDesc: Only compresses same-role mechanoids in the cluster sketch. Buildings, turrets, shields, problem causers, activation, and positions remain vanilla.
